# Ninja Shark Australia

> > Ninja Shark Australia specializes in innovative full-face snorkel masks with prescription lens options, lifetime warranties, and comprehensive water sports gear for adults and children.

Ninja Shark Australia is an e-commerce retailer focused on premium snorkelling equipment, particularly full-face snorkel masks featuring advanced technologies like anti-leak silicone linings, built-in wipers, and air circulation systems. The site serves customers across Australia with curated product collections, detailed safety and maintenance guides, and customer testimonials.

## Key Topics

- Full-face snorkel masks
- Prescription optical lenses
- Lifetime warranty
- Equaliser Pro
- Electra masks
- ClearView snorkel set
- Snorkelling gear
- Water sports equipment
- Adult and kids collections
- Package bundles
- Mask maintenance
- Safety guidelines
- Air circulation system
- Anti-leak technology
- Snorkel accessories

## Featured Products

- [Equaliser Full Face Snorkel Masks](https://ninjashark.com.au/products/equaliser-product-page): Equaliser Pro mask with nose-pinch feature for proper diving
- [Electra - Full Face Snorkel Mask](https://ninjashark.com.au/collections/all/products/electra-full-face-snorkelling-mask): Electra full-face snorkel mask with anti-leak silicone lining
- [ClearView - Snorkel Set & Goggles with Built-in Wipers](https://ninjashark.com.au/products/clearview-snorkel-set-goggles-with-built-in-wipers): ClearView snorkel set with innovative built-in wipers feature
- [Electra Kids Full Face Snorkel Mask](https://ninjashark.com.au/collections/all/products/electra-kids-full-face-snorkelling-mask): Electra Kids mask with smart air circulation system for children
